The recursive resolver in Hickory DNS (all versions of the hickory-recursor crate, and hickory-resolver 0.26.0 before 0.26.2) caches an empty connection pool when it follows a referral with no glue records and all queries for the name servers' IP addresses fail. An attacker able to spoof DNS responses can make these lookups fail, causing all subsequent queries for the affected zone to fail until the cache entry expires or is evicted.

The DNSSEC validation in the Hickory DNS hickory-net crate 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 identifies wraparound NSEC records by comparing the next domain name to an SOA record in the response, accepting that SOA even if it fails validation. Attackers who can supply DNS responses can combine a genuine NSEC record and its RRSIG with a crafted SOA record to forge nonexistence of any RRset.

Hickory DNS 0.25.0-alpha.3 through 0.25.2 contains a query amplification vulnerability in its recursive resolver, which mishandles cyclic sibling name server referrals that lack glue records. Attackers controlling two zones whose name servers reference each other without glue records can make the recursor loop, sending many upstream queries, amplified further by zero-TTL NS records.

The hickory-resolver component of Hickory DNS 0.25.0 before 0.26.2 follows irrelevant CNAME records when resolving recursive queries, sending queries that are unnecessary to answer the original request. Attackers controlling DNS responses can include CNAME records in the authority or additional sections, or outside the original query name's CNAME chain, causing excess resolver queries and increased query amplification.

The hickory-net crate in Hickory DNS 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 stops listening and returns an error when a client UDP connection receives a datagram that cannot be parsed as a DNS message. Remote attackers who guess the query's source port, without knowing the transaction ID, can spoof malformed responses to abort client queries, causing denial of service.

The recursive resolver in Hickory DNS hickory-recursor 0.25.0 through 0.25.2 and hickory-resolver 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 does not apply out-of-bailiwick filtering to negative responses. Attackers able to supply crafted negative responses can include out-of-bailiwick records to facilitate cache poisoning and more easily exploit other DNSSEC verification flaws.

The validating recursive resolver and validating forwarder in Hickory DNS (hickory-server) 0.25.0 before 0.26.2 do not check whether the SOA record passed DNSSEC validation when assembling NXDOMAIN or NODATA responses. An attacker able to supply forged DNS responses can have a forged SOA record returned to clients with the AD bit set, misleading clients that rely on the server's DNSSEC validation.

Hickory DNS hickory-proto through 0.26.0-alpha.1 and hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 contain a DNSSEC validation flaw that accepts a response as a positive answer when any valid RRset appears in the answer section, without checking that the RRset is responsive to the query. Attackers can supply signed but unrelated RRsets so that responses lacking matching records are validated as positive answers instead of as no-data responses.

Hickory DNS hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto through 0.26.0-alpha.1 perform insufficient checks on NSEC3 record names during DNSSEC verification, comparing only the hashed label without confirming the record belongs to the correct zone. Attackers can supply NSEC3 records from another zone with a matching hash label to forge DNSSEC nonexistence proofs.

DNSSEC validation in Hickory DNS hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto through 0.26.0-alpha.1 does not distinguish NODATA responses from wildcard-expanded positive responses. For a query that should return NODATA in a zone with wildcard records, an attacker can combine an NSEC3 record matching the query name with a signed wildcard record into a bogus positive response that validation accepts.

Hickory DNS hickory-net 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto 0.25.0 through 0.25.2 skip the check that a UDP response's question section matches the query when the response has an empty question section (QDCOUNT=0), and also skip the case-randomization check. Remote attackers able to inject spoofed UDP responses can send QDCOUNT=0 responses to bypass these checks, weakening defenses against DNS spoofing.

Hickory DNS from 0.24.0 before 0.26.2 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows remote attackers to consume server memory via unbounded DoH request bodies. Attackers can send large request bodies over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 to a DNS over HTTP server, causing memory exhaustion and denial of service.

Hickory DNS 0.24.0 through 0.26.1 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows remote attackers to consume server resources by sending incomplete DNS-over-QUIC request bodies. Attackers can open many connections and send only large length prefixes, causing pre-allocated buffers to persist without timeout and exhausting server memory.

Hickory DNS before 0.26.2 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in its DNS-over-HTTPS HTTP/2 server that lacks sufficient timeouts or limits for incomplete request bodies. Remote attackers can open DoH connections, send incomplete request bodies, and hold connections open to exhaust server memory.

The zone file parser in the hickory-proto crate of Hickory DNS 0.24.0 before 0.26.2 panics when a single token in a zone file is 4096 bytes or longer. Attackers who can supply untrusted zone files to an application using the parser can trigger the panic to cause a denial of service.

hickory-dns from 0.20.1 before 0.26.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the hickory-proto SVCB and HTTPS record presentation format parser. Attackers can supply untrusted zone files where only a single or double quote replaces a service parameter value, triggering a panic that crashes the parsing process.

Hickory-dns from 0.20.1 before 0.26.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the hickory-proto SVCB and HTTPS record presentation format parser, which panics on malformed alpn values. Attackers can supply untrusted zone files with unbalanced quotes, consecutive commas, or invalid escapes in alpn parameters to crash parsing processes.

Hickory DNS from 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in TSIG RDATA decoding that allows remote attackers to trigger a panic via malformed records. Attackers can send a crafted TSIG record in DNS wire format to cause unchecked subtraction underflow, crashing builds with overflow checks enabled and causing denial of service.

The DNS wire-format message parser in hickory-proto (Hickory DNS) 0.18 before 0.26.2 preallocates record vectors sized by the untrusted ANCOUNT, NSCOUNT, and ARCOUNT header fields before reading record data. Remote attackers can send a UDP datagram, or a spoofed response to a client/resolver, with these counts set to 65535, forcing about 18MB of allocation per message.

The devalue package for npm before 5.6.3 can consume excessive CPU and memory when serializing sparse arrays with uneval or stringify. An attacker who manages to get a sparse array created on the server, which mainstream wire formats do not allow, and serialized there can cause a denial of service.

Sveltejs devalue before 5.6.3 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows attackers to alter object prototypes by supplying untrusted data to uneval. When the generated code is later evaluated, it creates objects with polluted prototypes, producing output data whose shape differs from the original input.

Sveltejs devalue before 5.6.4 contains a prototype injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject __proto__ own properties into objects returned by devalue.parse and devalue.unflatten. Attackers can supply crafted serialized input that, when downstream code merges results via Object.assign, alters the target object's prototype.

Sveltejs devalue before 5.9.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to cause CPU amplification by supplying sparse arrays to uneval. Attackers who influence sparse values passed to uneval can force synchronous work proportional to the declared array length, blocking the event loop.

Sveltejs devalue before 5.9.3 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability where repeated primitive strings cause quadratic expansion in the uneval function. Attackers can supply a small crafted payload that is parsed and then passed to uneval, producing a very large serialized string that exhausts memory or CPU.

Sveltejs devalue from 1.0.0 before 5.9.3 contains a memory exhaustion flaw in uneval, whose generated code for sparse arrays allocates memory proportional to the array's declared length when evaluated. Attackers who can influence a very large sparse array serialized by an application can exhaust memory in the browser or runtime evaluating the output.

Devalue before 5.9.3 contains a validation bypass vulnerability that allows custom ArrayBuffer revivers to skip typed-array allocation checks in the parse function. Attackers can supply very small crafted input processed by a malformed ArrayBuffer reviver to allocate massive ArrayBuffers, causing memory exhaustion and denial of service.

devalue (sveltejs/devalue) 5.8.0 before 5.9.3 contains an unhandled promise rejection in stringifyAsync: when serializing multiple promises, a later promise rejecting before an earlier one settles leaves an internal rejection unhandled, even if the caller catches the returned promise. An attacker able to influence the timing or failure of serialized asynchronous values can terminate the Node.js process.

devalue before 5.9.3 allows malformed null-prototype object keys to bypass parse's __proto__ rejection through property-key coercion, an incomplete fix for GHSA-mwv9-gp5h-frr4. Attackers can supply crafted payloads that yield objects with a __proto__ own property, which alone does not cause prototype pollution.

Zebra before 7.0.0 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability that allows unauthenticated peers to stall initial sync by serving a forged checkpoint block body. Attackers can supply a body with forged authorizing data near the final checkpoint, leaving rejected hashes in the sent-hash set so the node stops requesting blocks until restart.

Zebra before 7.0.0 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows unauthenticated peers to exhaust verification threads by submitting transactions with many transparent inputs. Attackers can relay invalid transactions with tens of thousands of inputs, forcing quadratic ZIP-244 or ZIP-243 digest recomputation that stalls Rayon-backed block verification for minutes.

Zebra zebrad before 7.0.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows a malicious peer to stall checkpoint sync by cancelling the verifier rewind after a failed commit. Attackers can serve a forged block with altered authorizing data plus a restart-triggering block, leaving the verifier rejecting honest blocks until restart.

ZcashFoundation Zebra zebrad before 7.0.0 contains a reachable assertion race condition that allows unauthenticated remote peers to abort the node by triggering disconnection during a blocked outbound send. Malicious peers can return empty FindBlocks or FindHeaders replies and stop reading their socket, dropping an unresolved MustUseClientResponseSender and terminating syncing nodes.

ZcashFoundation Zebra from 4.5.0 before 7.0.0 contains a protection mechanism failure that bans honest peers by scoring mempool lock-time rejections at the ban threshold. Attackers can broadcast transactions locked until the current height right after each block, causing lagging nodes to ban honest relaying peers for 24 hours or until restart.

Zebra from 2.3.0 before 7.0.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated peers to evade misbehavior scoring by sending transactions or blocks with invalid transparent scripts. Attackers can flood mempool with script-failing transactions or serve forged v5 block bodies with altered scriptSig bytes to exhaust CPU and repeatedly stall block sync.

Zebra zebrad 6.4.0 before 7.0.0 performs quadratic work in the mempool coinbase-maturity check because Transaction::coinbase_spend_restriction() rebuilds the transaction's output list once per spent outpoint. Any connected peer can repeatedly send unsigned transactions with many transparent inputs and outputs, which are rejected without a misbehavior score, to pin verification threads.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 ships built-in identities in the Top Level Realm (demo, anonymous, wsc, wsp, SecurityTokenService and agentAuth) with passwords that are identical on every installation, publicly known, and able to authenticate. Unauthenticated remote attackers can log in as these identities to obtain authenticated sessions, and the agent identities can read the configuration of other agent profiles.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in certificate CRL checking that fetches CRLs from the distribution point named in a presented certificate without restricting the destination or verifying the downloaded CRL's signature. Attackers holding a trusted-CA-chained certificate can make OpenAM request internal hosts, capture configured CRL update credentials, overwrite stored revocation data to block certificate authentication for that CA, and tie up authentication threads.

OpenAM from 14.0.0 before 16.1.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read live session tokens from the notification WebSocket. Attackers can bypass the agent-only check through an unvalidated internal forward on legacy Liberty ID-FF endpoints, collecting iPlanetDirectoryPro tokens to hijack user and administrator sessions.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its SAML v2.0 service provider that accepts unsigned assertions on the ECP (PAOS) and HTTP-Artifact bindings when WantAssertionsSigned is false. Unauthenticated remote attackers can submit forged assertions to obtain sessions as any mapped user, including administrators, and hijack single sign-on to dependent applications.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 fails to enforce the Valid Creation Attributes list during self-registration, allowing anonymous attackers to set restricted attributes including group membership. Attackers can register through the legacy self-service REST endpoint or User Self-Service flow to join administrative groups and gain full administrative control of OpenAM.

OpenIdentityPlatform OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an open redirect because WS-Federation logout, SAML v2.0 logout and name-identifier management, SAML v2.0 identity provider finder, and some authentication pages do not check destination URLs against allowed lists. Attackers can craft OpenAM-domain links that send users to arbitrary external sites for phishing.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows attackers to redirect users to external sites because RelayState is unchecked when no relayStateUrlList is configured. Attackers can craft single sign-on links with a malicious RelayState to send users from the trusted OpenAM origin to phishing sites and bypass URL filters.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an open redirect and cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows remote attackers to control post-login and logout destinations via the goto and gotoOnFail parameters. Attackers can craft OpenAM login or logout links that redirect victims to phishing sites or run script in the XUI to steal session cookies.

OpenAM from 14.5.1 before 16.1.4 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the OAuth 2.0 device authorization flow that allows attackers to approve device codes when consent is skipped for implied-consent clients. Attackers can start a device authorization and lure a logged-in user to a crafted page, obtaining access and ID tokens to call APIs as that user.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 and its client SDK fail to sufficiently validate responses on the internal server-to-server SOAP channel, allowing network-positioned attackers to affect integrity and availability. Attackers who intercept unencrypted traffic or control a site server can crash receiving processes, tamper with writable files, and possibly execute code.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources by sending serialized Java data without size or structure limits. Attackers can send small crafted requests to remote SDK endpoints, classic login pages, or the administration console to block authentication, session validation and policy decisions.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 fails to enforce PKCE in the OAuth 2.0 device authorization flow, never validating the code verifier when device codes are exchanged for tokens. Attackers who obtain an approved device code from client logs or shared device storage can redeem it for access and ID tokens to impersonate the user.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to redirect users after SAML 1.x single sign-on by exploiting loose trusted-partner destination matching. Attackers can craft links to /SAMLAwareServlet or /SAMLPOSTProfileServlet with a destination host resembling a trusted partner to send authenticated users to attacker-controlled phishing sites.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an incomplete output encoding vulnerability that allows a SAML 1.x identity provider to alter attribute values by injecting unencoded content into the service provider auto-submitted form. Attackers controlling a trusted identity provider can craft assertion attribute names or values that reach the target application in modified form, undermining the integrity of received attributes.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows privileged attackers to inject script by placing markup in a user's display name. When the victim reaches the OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect consent page, the unencoded name executes script that can steal the OpenAM session cookie to impersonate the user.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 does not verify that a signed SAML 1.x assertion or response was signed by the partner named as its issuer, accepting a signature from any certificate in OpenAM's keystore. An attacker holding such a private key, such as a trusted SAML 1.x partner, can forge assertions claiming another partner's issuer and sign in as that partner's users, including privileged ones.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows parties registering UMA resource sets to trigger internal requests through unvalidated scope description URLs. Attackers can register resource sets with scope URLs pointing to internal hosts or cloud metadata endpoints, which OpenAM fetches when sending pending-request notification emails, enabling internal network probing.

OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows administrators, including delegated realm administrators, to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs through federation configuration wizard metadata URLs. Attackers can enter metadata or OpenID Connect discovery URLs pointing to internal hosts or cloud metadata endpoints to probe the internal network and read partial responses.

Tornado before 6.6 does not validate the max_age argument of RequestHandler.set_cookie (also called by set_signed_cookie, set_secure_cookie, and clear_cookie), allowing injection of additional Set-Cookie attributes. When an application passes attacker-influenced input as max_age, an attacker can embed attributes such as Domain, Path, or Secure to widen the cookie's scope to parent paths or other subdomains.

Tornado before 6.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in RequestHandler.static_url() and get_version() that allows attackers to hash files outside static_path using ../ sequences. Attackers controlling input passed to static_url() can obtain SHA-512 hashes of readable files to confirm their existence, or reference /dev/zero to block the event loop indefinitely.

gix-commitgraph before 0.42.0, as used in gitoxide before 0.61.0, contains a denial of service vulnerability because its commit-graph parser does not validate parent graph positions against the declared commit count or check the EDGE chunk length for 4-byte alignment. Attackers can supply a repository containing a crafted .git/objects/info/commit-graph file to trigger panics that abort gix merge-base, gix blame, and applications embedding gix.

gix-fs in gitoxide before 0.24.1 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to capture NTLM credentials by supplying UNC symlink targets in a crafted repository. When a victim checks out the repository on Windows with symlinks enabled, gix_fs::symlink::create calls is_dir() on the UNC target, triggering SMB authentication that leaks the username, domain, and NTLMv2 hash.

Vikunja from 1.0.0 before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass service.maxitemsperpage by sending page=0 to /api/v1 list endpoints. Attackers can self-register and repeatedly request page=0 to force unbounded SQL queries, memory materialisation, and per-row query fan-out, degrading availability for other users.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows attackers holding a stolen session to enroll and enable TOTP without the account password. Attackers can call the TOTP enroll and enable endpoints with their own secret to lock the owner out, persisting even after password reset.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a stored CSS injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with project write access to inject arbitrary CSS via unsanitized table-cell data-background-color attributes. Attackers can store crafted task descriptions or comments to render full-viewport phishing overlays or force zero-click outbound background-image requests that deanonymize viewers.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows holders of revoked access tokens to keep authenticating because SetupTokenMiddleware skips session and account-status checks. Attackers with a stolen token can, after logout, password reset, or account disabling, mint OAuth sessions via /oauth/authorize or tk_ API tokens for persistent access.

Vikunja from 2.4.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows token holders to perform unintended operations due to colliding v1 and v2 API token permission keys. Attackers with a token scoped to read project backgrounds can delete them via the v2 DELETE background route, and bucket create-only tokens can update existing buckets.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a mass assignment vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to set the read-only external_id field through the team create and update endpoints. Attackers can tag a team they create or administer as externally managed, permanently blocking removal of every member and causing SSO members to be dropped from the team at their next login.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 allocates memory without limits in its Trello, Todoist and Microsoft To Do migration importers, which buffer remote attachment downloads and API responses in memory without size caps. Authenticated users can start a migration that references huge attacker-served attachments or yields oversized API responses, exhausting memory and crashing the shared API process for all tenants.

Vikunja from 0.23.0 before 2.7.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows project collaborators with write access to read tasks from inaccessible projects by registering webhooks. Because webhook payloads are built with the triggering user's permissions, attackers receive related_tasks titles, descriptions and metadata from private projects whenever another user modifies a linked task.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory by requesting avatars at many distinct sizes. Attackers can upload a noisy avatar and fetch it at each size up to 1024, caching roughly a gigabyte per account without eviction and causing the API process to be OOM-killed.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read any task by injecting a crafted task object into a no-op Kanban bucket move. Attackers can set task.id to a victim task and task.project_id to their own project, routing full task contents to their webhook and forging mention notifications.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts vulnerability that allows session holders to brute-force account passwords via unthrottled re-authentication endpoints. Attackers with a stolen session can guess the password via /user/settings/totp/disable without lockout, then disable TOTP without a code for persistent account takeover.

Vikunja from 0.18.0 before 2.7.1 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows team owners to gain admin or ownership of read-only shared projects by deleting accounts. Attackers can create a bot, add it to their team, and delete it through the bots endpoint, triggering ensureProjectAdminUser to promote read-only shares and lock out the real owner.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust API process memory by uploading WeKan or vikunja-file imports with no item-count cap. Attackers can submit a ~22 MB WeKan JSON with hundreds of thousands of cards or duplicate IDs to the wekan migrate endpoint, triggering OOM and crashing the instance.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in TaskBucket.CanUpdate, which checks write access to the bucket's project and to the task separately but never verifies that both belong to the same project. Authenticated users with write access to two projects can move a task into another project's kanban bucket. This persists cross-project task_buckets rows that count toward bucket limits and, for done buckets, toggle the task's done state.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to determine whether private teams exist by calling the team member self-removal endpoint. Attackers can send DELETE requests to /teams/{id}/members/{own username} for arbitrary team ids and use the distinguishable responses to learn if a team exists, is SSO-managed, or has a single member.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the vikunja-file ZIP importer that allows authenticated users to consume CPU and memory by uploading archives with excessive entries. Attackers can upload export ZIPs containing many empty or non-files/ entries that bypass the per-entry caps, forcing scanArchive to process every entry twice.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a client-side request forgery vulnerability that allows users with write access to make viewers' clients request loopback or LAN addresses by storing img elements in rich text. Attackers can plant images in tasks, comments, project descriptions, or imported Markdown to trigger blind GET requests against local services and track when viewers open content.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an improper resource cleanup vulnerability that leaves full-data export archives orphaned on disk after re-exports, failed exports, or account deletion. Authenticated users can repeatedly re-trigger exports containing all their attachments to exhaust disk storage, while deleted users' personal data remains retained indefinitely.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows attackers to steal stored auth tokens by inducing users to switch the frontend API URL. Because checkAndSetApiUrl leaves origin-independent localStorage tokens in place, the bearer token and desktop OAuth refresh token are sent to the attacker's server, enabling account takeover.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 embeds live password-reset, email-confirmation and account-deletion tokens in the URL query string of emailed links, so the full request URI, including the token, is written to Vikunja's HTTP access log and any reverse-proxy logs when a user clicks the link. Attackers with read access to those logs can replay an unredeemed password-reset token to take over the account or an account-deletion token to confirm the deletion.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated CalDAV clients to create unbounded dummy tasks by sending VTODOs with thousands of RELATED-TO properties. Attackers can repeat unknown related UIDs in a single PUT request to generate thousands of task, relation, and event rows, bloating the database and overloading the event pipeline.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 fails to re-anchor PluginsDir and LogPath to service.rootpath, allowing plugins to load from and logs to be written in the startup working directory. Local attackers able to write to that directory can plant plugins loaded into the server when plugins are enabled, or read misplaced logs including audit.log.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows project writers or view admins to create unlimited kanban buckets due to missing count caps. Attackers can create thousands of buckets so every kanban read runs a task SELECT and COUNT per bucket, generating heavy database load.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a supply chain vulnerability in its mage release targets that fetch the xgo module and Docker image by mutable latest references. Attackers who compromise the upstream xgo module, image, or registry can inject malicious code into subsequently built release binaries shipped under a valid signature.

Vikunja from 0.24.0 before 2.7.1 contains a nil pointer dereference vulnerability that allows project admins to break project views by saving a filter-mode bucket configuration with a null filter. Because validateProjectViewFilters skips nil entries, every subsequent read of the view panics in kanban and task collection code, returning HTTP 500 to all project members.

Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows holders of tokens scoped only to projects_webhooks to manage the owner's user-level webhooks by supplying user_id in request bodies. Attackers can register user webhooks to their own receiver to obtain reminders and task payloads from all owner projects, and read, change or delete existing user webhooks.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insecure file permissions vulnerability that allows local users to read stored data because localStorage.Write creates blobs world-readable. Local attackers on a shared host can read attachments, project backgrounds and exports, and copy the SQLite database to crack password hashes offline.

Vikunja from 0.22.0 before 2.7.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows read-only project members to view full webhook target URLs by listing project webhooks. Attackers can extract incoming-webhook tokens or API keys embedded in target_url values to post to receiving channels or reuse keys until rotated.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in canDoBucket that allows users with project write access to delete buckets via a mismatched view ID. Attackers can request deletion through another view's bucket endpoint to bypass the last-bucket rule, leaving dangling default/done bucket references and inconsistent task buckets.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that allows log readers to obtain link-share hashes because the request logger records the raw URI of the /shares/:share/auth route. Attackers with access to Vikunja or reverse proxy access logs can reuse non-expiring, non-password-protected share hashes to obtain a project JWT with read, write or admin permission.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust server memory through concurrent image decodes in avatar and background uploads. Attackers can send several parallel tiny, highly compressible PNGs decoded at up to 50 megapixels each, pushing the API process into memory pressure or an OOM kill.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains an insecure file permissions vulnerability that allows local users to read dump archives created with umask permissions by the vikunja dump command. Local attackers on a shared host can read the world-readable zip in the rootpath to obtain config, password hashes, TOTP secrets, tokens, and stored files.

Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious repository authors to capture API tokens by specifying an attacker-controlled server in .veans.yml. When veans runs in an untrusted checkout, it sends VEANS_TOKEN as a Bearer token, or login passwords, TOTP codes and tokens, to that server, granting attackers the victim's Vikunja access.

Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a prompt injection vulnerability that allows project members with write access to inject instructions by setting project titles or task content rendered verbatim inside the coding agent's authoritative instruction block. Attackers can craft ProjectTitle or task descriptions that the prime hook loads on SessionStart and PreCompact, causing the agent to modify the developer's checkout or run commands.

Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a protocol downgrade vulnerability in serverCandidates that allows on-path attackers to force plain HTTP during veans init and login. Attackers can block HTTPS ports so discovery accepts an unverified HTTP response, capturing passwords, TOTP codes or bot tokens and persisting cleartext API traffic.

Vikunja veans before 2.7.1 contains a symlink following vulnerability that allows attackers to make veans init write files outside the repository via crafted repo symlinks. Attackers can ship symlinked .veans.yml, .claude, or .opencode entries to overwrite user files like ~/.bashrc or install veans hooks and plugins globally.

Vikunja 2.0.0 before 2.7.1 accepts form-encoded bodies on the /api/v2 login and OIDC callback endpoints without CSRF or Origin checks, enabling login cross-site request forgery. An attacker with an account can lure a victim to a page posting the attacker's credentials or OIDC code, switching the victim into the attacker's account and exposing data the victim then adds.

Vikunja before 2.7.1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to import their data into a victim's account because the Todoist, Microsoft To Do, and Trello migration OAuth callbacks lack a bound state parameter. Attackers can authorize their own account, keep the unused callback code or token, and lure a logged-in victim to the migration callback route to auto-import attacker-chosen projects and tasks containing phishing links.

Vikunja from 2.4.0 before 2.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows disabled or locked users to retain access through API tokens owned by their bot users. Because token validation only checks the bot's own status, attackers holding pre-minted bot tokens can keep reading and modifying shared projects via the HTTP API, CalDAV, MCP and feeds.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to broken object-level authorization.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to broken object-level authorization.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to SQL injection.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 uses weaker than expected cryptographic algorithms that could allow an attacker to decrypt highly sensitive information.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 could allow a local attacker to obtain sensitive information due to the use of a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 could allow an attacker with access to stored data to decrypt sensitive credentials due to the use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. The key protecting stored credentials is built into the product, so credentials could be decrypted if the stored data is obtained.

ai.summary_en: The day's vulnerability curation reveals a severe concentration of remote code execution, authentication bypasses, and unsafe deserialization attacks targeting web applications, cloud environments, and emerging AI/ML toolchains. Prominent vendors and products including IBM QRadar, Oracle middleware, RustDesk, and Kubernetes management interfaces suffer from critical flaws allowing unauthorized access, container escapes, and full system compromise via memory corruption or logic errors. Additionally, significant risks persist in desktop and IoT sectors, where developers face threats from malicious extensions and reverse engineering suites, while embedded devices remain vulnerable to firmware manipulation and unauthenticated command injection.
ai.summary_zh: 今日漏洞梳理显示，针对 Web 应用、云环境和新兴 AI/ML 工具链的远程代码执行、身份验证绕过及不安全反序列化攻击高度集中。IBM QRadar、Oracle 中间件、RustDesk 以及 Kubernetes 管理界面等知名厂商及产品存在严重缺陷，可导致未授权访问、容器逃逸，并通过内存损坏或逻辑错误实现完整系统接管。此外，桌面和物联网领域仍存在重大风险，开发者面临恶意扩展和逆向工程套件威胁，而嵌入式设备则易受固件篡改和未认证命令注入的影响。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation to SYSTEM in major Windows antivirus suites allows attackers to fully compromise host systems during file shredding operations.
items.reason_zh: 主要Windows防病毒套件中的本地提权至SYSTEM漏洞，允许攻击者在文件粉碎操作期间完全控制主机系统。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in RustDesk's Windows clipboard redirection enables remote code execution when malicious peers paste oversized payloads into standard applications.
items.reason_zh: RustDesk的Windows剪贴板重定向功能存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，当恶意对等节点将超大载荷粘贴到标准应用程序中时，可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Prototype pollution in exceljs affects desktop spreadsheet workflows by modifying Object.prototype through crafted cell notes, potentially breaking application logic.
items.reason_zh: exceljs存在原型链污染漏洞，可通过构造的单元格注释修改Object.prototype，影响桌面电子表格工作流，可能导致应用程序逻辑崩溃。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in GNU Emacs image loader leaks heap memory contents via crafted PBM/PPM files with large dimensions.
items.reason_zh: GNU Emacs图像加载器存在整数溢出漏洞，可通过构造的大尺寸PBM/PPM文件泄露堆内存内容。

items.reason_en: Critical memory-safety flaw in the Ladybird browser's WebAssembly loader can lead to remote code execution when processing malicious ESM modules.
items.reason_zh: Ladybird浏览器的WebAssembly加载器存在关键内存安全缺陷，在处理恶意ESM模块时可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Enables arbitrary JavaScript execution via unsanitized LLM responses in the Zotero extension, directly compromising researcher workflows and local data privacy.
items.reason_zh: Zotero扩展程序通过未过滤的LLM响应实现任意JavaScript代码执行，直接破坏研究人员的工作流程和本地数据隐私。

items.reason_en: Allows local attackers to recursively delete arbitrary directories by exploiting path validation flaws during project deletion in the reverse engineering suite.
items.reason_zh: 该逆向工程套件在项目删除过程中存在路径验证缺陷，允许本地攻击者递归删除任意目录。

items.reason_en: Markdown Preview Enhanced evaluates untrusted markdown content via eval(), allowing arbitrary JavaScript execution that compromises developer workstations using VS Code.
items.reason_zh: Markdown Preview Enhanced插件通过eval()评估不受信任的Markdown内容，允许任意JavaScript代码执行，从而危及使用VS Code的开发人员工作站。

items.reason_en: Music Player Daemon contains a stack buffer overflow in its PCM decoder plugin, enabling local attackers to corrupt memory and potentially achieve code execution.
items.reason_zh: Music Player Daemon的PCM解码器插件存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许本地攻击者破坏内存并可能实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: CodexBar CLI installer suffers from a race condition during temporary file handling, allowing local users to escalate privileges to root during installation.
items.reason_zh: CodexBar CLI安装程序在临时文件处理过程中存在竞态条件漏洞，允许本地用户在安装期间将权限提升至root。

items.reason_en: Custom URL scheme handler allows remote command execution via crafted links, posing a significant threat to macOS users browsing malicious web content.
items.reason_zh: 自定义URL方案处理器允许通过构造的链接实现远程命令执行，对浏览恶意网页内容的macOS用户构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Heap-buffer-overflow in the FreeRDP graphics cache module enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting memory corruption during session rendering.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP图形缓存模块存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许远程攻击者通过在会话渲染期间利用内存破坏来执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the cgltf_validate function triggers out-of-bounds reads when processing crafted 3D model files, potentially crashing desktop applications or leaking sensitive memory contents.
items.reason_zh: cgltf_validate函数存在整数溢出漏洞，在处理构造的3D模型文件时会触发越界读取，可能导致桌面应用程序崩溃或敏感内存内容泄露。

items.reason_en: Local users can repeatedly decrement reference counts via the /dev/crypto interface to trigger use-after-free conditions, risking privilege escalation or system instability on Linux-based workstations.
items.reason_zh: 本地用户可通过/dev/crypto接口反复递减引用计数以触发释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，导致基于Linux的工作站面临权限提升或系统不稳定的风险。

items.reason_en: Malicious Ghidra projects with crafted Swift tool directory paths trigger arbitrary binary execution upon opening, directly compromising reverse engineering environments and developer machines.
items.reason_zh: 包含构造Swift工具目录路径的恶意Ghidra项目在打开时会触发任意二进制文件执行，直接危及逆向工程环境和开发人员计算机。

items.reason_en: Password authentication bypass in OpenSSH on musl libc configurations allows unauthorized access using passwords between 256 and 1024 characters due to hash misinterpretation.
items.reason_zh: musl libc配置下的OpenSSH存在密码认证绕过漏洞，由于哈希值误解析，攻击者可利用256至1024个字符的密码进行未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the code100x mobile API allows unauthenticated attackers to forge identity headers and impersonate arbitrary users across the platform.
items.reason_zh: code100x移动API存在认证绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者伪造身份头并在整个平台冒充任意用户。

items.reason_en: Permits co-resident malicious apps to write files outside intended cache directories via crafted content provider intents, breaking mobile sandbox isolation.
items.reason_zh: 允许共存的恶意应用通过构造的内容提供者意图将文件写入预期缓存目录之外，破坏移动沙箱隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Invalid inventory transaction handling allows remote attackers to trigger server crashes on PocketMine-MP instances, disrupting availability for popular mobile gaming communities.
items.reason_zh: 无效的库存事务处理允许远程攻击者在PocketMine-MP实例上触发服务器崩溃，影响热门移动游戏社区的可用性。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in IBM Storage TS4500 Library firmware enables remote authenticated attackers to perform unauthorized account takeovers.
items.reason_zh: IBM Storage TS4500 Library固件存在授权不当漏洞，允许远程已认证攻击者执行未授权的账户接管。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in HKUDS OpenHarness allows external senders to execute arbitrary OS commands through a misconfigured Slack slash command bridge.
items.reason_zh: HKUDS OpenHarness存在远程代码执行漏洞，外部发送方可通过配置错误的Slack斜杠命令桥接器执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers can write arbitrary files to the host filesystem during initial setup by manipulating backup archive names, fully compromising smart home devices.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的攻击者可通过操纵备份归档文件名，在安装初期向主机文件系统写入任意文件，从而完全控制智能家居设备。

items.reason_en: Exploits flawed tar archive parsing during backup restoration to overwrite critical system files via absolute symlink targets.
items.reason_zh: 利用备份恢复过程中tar归档解析缺陷，通过绝对符号链接目标覆盖关键系统文件。

items.reason_en: Leaves internal state flags incorrectly set after rejecting oversized MQTT topics, causing subsequent TCP segment processing failures that crash embedded network stacks.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝超大的MQTT主题后错误设置内部状态标志，导致后续TCP段处理失败，进而使嵌入式网络协议栈崩溃。

items.reason_en: Ignores buffer length arguments in the LwM2M TLV parser, enabling out-of-bounds reads that can destabilize constrained IoT device communication.
items.reason_zh: LwM2M TLV解析器忽略缓冲区长度参数，导致越界读取，可能破坏受限物联网设备的通信稳定性。

items.reason_en: RTKLIB contains an out-of-bounds write in its RTCM3 decoder, allowing attackers controlling GNSS correction streams to crash or compromise embedded navigation receivers.
items.reason_zh: RTKLIB的RTCM3解码器存在越界写入漏洞，允许控制GNSS校正流的攻击者使嵌入式导航接收机崩溃或被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Marlin Firmware has an out-of-bounds write in its bed leveling handler, enabling attackers to corrupt firmware memory and potentially take control of 3D printers.
items.reason_zh: Marlin Firmware的床面调平处理程序存在越界写入漏洞，允许攻击者破坏固件内存并可能控制3D打印机。

items.reason_en: Ground Station software allows unauthenticated database destruction and data injection via Socket.IO, threatening satellite and IoT telemetry infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 地面站软件允许通过Socket.IO进行未认证的数据库破坏和数据注入，威胁卫星与物联网遥测基础设施。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow and undersized heap allocation in the barebox EFI PE loader allow remote attackers to corrupt firmware memory during device boot processes.
items.reason_zh: barebox EFI PE加载器存在整数溢出和堆分配过小漏洞，允许远程攻击者在设备启动过程中破坏固件内存。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in DHCP option parsing permits network-based attackers to extract sensitive memory contents from embedded devices broadcasting on the same segment.
items.reason_zh: DHCP选项解析存在越界读取漏洞，允许基于网络的攻击者从同一网段广播的嵌入式设备中提取敏感内存内容。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized user input interpolated into shell commands via rc/index.php allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands as root on smart home hubs.
items.reason_zh: 通过 rc/index.php 将未过滤的用户输入插入到 Shell 命令中，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者在智能家庭集线器上以 root 权限执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Unsaniized HTTP parameters in the WiFi captive portal CGI script enable remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root, compromising embedded IoT device firmware.
items.reason_zh: WiFi 强制门户 CGI 脚本中存在未过滤的 HTTP 参数，使远程攻击者能够以 root 权限执行任意命令，从而破坏嵌入式物联网设备固件。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted pickle data over unauthenticated gRPC channels allows network-reachable attackers to execute arbitrary code in robotics control and teleoperation systems.
items.reason_zh: 在未经身份验证的 gRPC 通道上反序列化不受信任的 pickle 数据，允许网络可达的攻击者在机器人控制和遥操作系统中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Missing super-administrator checks allow realm administrators to modify global Keycloak redirect URLs, potentially hijacking IoT device authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: 缺少超级管理员检查机制，导致域管理员可以修改全局 Keycloak 重定向 URL，可能劫持物联网设备的认证流程。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Juniper Session Smart Router ConfigDirector allows authenticated REST users to read, overwrite, or delete critical certificate and key files.
items.reason_zh: Juniper Session Smart Router ConfigDirector 中的路径遍历漏洞允许经过身份验证的 REST 用户读取、覆盖或删除关键的证书和密钥文件。

items.reason_en: Absolute path traversal in IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data exposes sensitive configuration and log files to authenticated remote attackers.
items.reason_zh: Cloud Pak for Data 上的 IBM DataStage 存在绝对路径遍历漏洞，使经过身份验证的远程攻击者能够访问敏感的配置和日志文件。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in DeepSeek Harness accepts spoofed loopback Host headers, granting unauthenticated access to local HTTP agent-control APIs.
items.reason_zh: DeepSeek Harness 中的身份验证绕过漏洞接受伪造的回环 Host 头，授予对本地 HTTP 代理控制 API 的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: LLM proxy identity spoofing in Headroom allows clients to manipulate the x-headroom-user-id header, hijacking session ownership and memory allocation.
items.reason_zh: Headroom 中的 LLM 代理身份伪造漏洞允许客户端操纵 x-headroom-user-id 头，劫持会话所有权和内存分配。

items.reason_en: Bypasses security flag checks in Kubernetes management tools by injecting leading dashes into parameters, granting unauthorized cluster control.
items.reason_zh: 通过在参数中注入前导连字符，绕过 Kubernetes 管理工具的安全标志检查，从而获得未经授权的集群控制权。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote attackers achieve OS command injection by exploiting missing exit calls and unsanitized input in container monitoring dashboards.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的远程攻击者利用容器监控仪表盘中缺失的退出调用和未过滤的输入实现 OS 命令注入。

items.reason_en: Compromises CI/CD pipelines by trusting attacker-controlled commit author names to bypass approval gates, enabling malicious code deployment.
items.reason_zh: 通过信任攻击者控制的提交作者名称来绕过审批关卡，从而破坏 CI/CD 流水线并启用恶意代码部署。

items.reason_en: Trusts attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-Host headers for OIDC discovery, allowing service mesh authentication bypass and token forgery.
items.reason_zh: 在 OIDC 发现过程中信任攻击者控制的 X-Forwarded-Host 头，允许绕过服务网格身份验证并伪造令牌。

items.reason_en: Dockhand exposes an authentication bypass in its git webhook endpoints, allowing unauthenticated attackers to trigger arbitrary stack redeployments and compromise CI/CD pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Dockhand 在其 Git Webhook 端点中暴露了身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者触发任意的堆栈重新部署并破坏 CI/CD 流水线。

items.reason_en: Capgo allows scope escalation where app-limited API keys can mint unrestricted org-wide keys, breaking multi-tenant isolation in Supabase-based applications.
items.reason_zh: Capgo 允许作用域提升，使得仅限应用范围的 API 密钥可生成无限制的组织级密钥，破坏基于 Supabase 的应用程序的多租户隔离。

items.reason_en: Cap-go features an authentication logic flaw that lets attackers register accounts bound to victim emails before verification, leading to account takeover via forced 2FA enrollment.
items.reason_zh: Cap-go 存在身份验证逻辑缺陷，允许攻击者在验证前注册绑定受害者邮箱的账户，从而导致通过强制启用双重认证接管账户。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks allow provider service users to arbitrarily add organizations, leading to complete tenant takeover in multi-tenant deployments.
items.reason_zh: 缺少授权检查机制，允许服务提供商服务用户随意添加组织，在多租户部署中导致完整的租户接管。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass enables editor users to modify trace configurations across tenant boundaries, compromising isolation in AI application orchestration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证绕过漏洞使编辑用户能够跨租户边界修改跟踪配置，破坏 AI 应用编排平台的隔离性。

items.reason_en: Incorrect nsjail sandbox configuration bind-mounts /etc without restrictions, allowing authenticated users to tamper with system hostfiles and SSL certificates.
items.reason_zh: 错误的 nsjail 沙箱配置无限制地挂载 /etc 目录，允许经过身份验证的用户篡改系统 hosts 文件和 SSL 证书。

items.reason_en: Trusted operators can escape container network isolation by configuring docker.network parameters, enabling lateral movement and unauthorized access to adjacent microservices.
items.reason_zh: 受信任的操作员可通过配置 docker.network 参数逃逸容器网络隔离，实现横向移动并未经授权访问相邻微服务。

items.reason_en: Authenticated attackers can inject SQL through folder ownership parameters to extract sensitive data like JWT signing keys, completely undermining platform authentication and tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: 经过身份验证的攻击者可通过文件夹所有权参数注入 SQL，提取如 JWT 签名密钥等敏感数据，完全破坏平台身份验证和多租户隔离。

items.reason_en: Binding sandbox agents to all network interfaces with empty API keys disables authentication, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution in AI development and orchestration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 使用空 API 密钥将沙箱代理绑定到所有网络接口会禁用身份验证，允许在 AI 开发和编排平台上进行未经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Known exploited in the wild, this vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via the validate/code endpoint, posing immediate risk to AI workflow deployments.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已在野外被已知利用，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者通过 validate/code 端点执行任意代码，对 AI 工作流部署构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged authenticated users can inject shell commands via unvalidated DNS record types, escalating to root execution and compromising self-hosted cloud hosting panels.
items.reason_zh: 低权限经过身份验证的用户可通过未验证的 DNS 记录类型注入 Shell 命令，提权至 root 执行并破坏自托管云主机控制面板。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in the apiCall namespace clamp allows tenant workloads to issue cross-namespace and cluster-scoped API requests by exploiting malformed percent-escapes.
items.reason_zh: apiCall 命名空间限制中的授权绕过漏洞允许租户工作负载通过利用格式错误的百分号转义发起跨命名空间和集群范围的 API 请求。

items.reason_en: Policy templating flaw enables namespaced tenants to generate arbitrary Kubernetes resource kinds across any namespace, breaking multi-tenant isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 策略模板化缺陷使命名空间租户能够在任何命名空间中生成任意 Kubernetes 资源类型，破坏多租户隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Case-sensitivity mishandling in IBM API Connect access controls permits unauthorized administrative operations and sensitive data exposure across API gateways.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 访问控制中对大小写敏感性处理不当，允许未经授权的管理操作并在 API 网关间泄露敏感数据。

items.reason_en: XML external entity injection in schema processing allows remote attackers to retrieve sensitive server-side files and perform server-side request forgery.
items.reason_zh: Schema 处理中的 XML 外部实体注入漏洞允许远程攻击者检索敏感的服务器端文件并执行服务器端请求伪造。

items.reason_en: Insufficiently random default credential generation in Netflix Lemur allows attackers to brute-force or guess secrets, compromising certificate and secret management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Netflix Lemur 中默认凭据生成的随机性不足，允许攻击者暴力破解或猜测密钥，破坏证书和密钥管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in IBM SevOne Network Performance Management enables remote attackers to trigger denial of service conditions.
items.reason_zh: IBM SevOne Network Performance Management 中存在资源消耗失控漏洞，使远程攻击者能够触发拒绝服务条件。

items.reason_en: Reflected cross-site scripting in IBM QRadar targets authenticated administrators via crafted URLs, potentially enabling session hijacking or phishing.
items.reason_zh: IBM QRadar 中的反射型跨站脚本漏洞通过构造的 URL 针对经过身份验证的管理员，可能导致会话劫持或网络钓鱼。

items.reason_en: Unbounded decompression in parsedmarc allows remote attackers to exhaust server CPU and memory resources through highly compressed DMARC report attachments.
items.reason_zh: parsedmarc中的无界解压缩漏洞允许远程攻击者通过高度压缩的DMARC报告附件耗尽服务器的CPU和内存资源。

items.reason_en: Triggers null pointer dereferences in Kerberos analyzers via crafted error messages, causing network traffic sensors to crash.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造的错误消息在Kerberos分析器中触发空指针解引用，导致网络流量传感器崩溃。

items.reason_en: Causes uncontrolled memory consumption during FTP GSSAPI negotiations, leading to process termination and network visibility loss.
items.reason_zh: 在FTP GSSAPI协商期间导致不受控的内存消耗，进而引发进程终止和网络可见性丢失。

items.reason_en: Generates cryptographically weak one-time tokens for VPN peers, allowing brute-force recovery of connection credentials.
items.reason_zh: 为VPN对等体生成密码学强度不足的一次性令牌，使攻击者能够通过暴力破解恢复连接凭据。

items.reason_en: Circumvents IP-based access restrictions by routing traffic through WebSocket upgrades that bypass standard firewall rules.
items.reason_zh: 通过将流量路由至WebSocket升级通道，绕过标准防火墙规则，从而规避基于IP的访问限制。

items.reason_en: Tinyproxy fails to reject requests with multiple conflicting Content-Length headers, enabling request smuggling and backend desynchronization attacks against proxy deployments.
items.reason_zh: Tinyproxy未能拒绝包含多个冲突Content-Length头的请求，从而导致针对代理部署的请求走私与后端不同步攻击。

items.reason_en: libssh2 contains an out-of-bounds write in packet reading due to missing upper bounds on packet length, allowing remote attackers to corrupt heap memory and execute code in SSH-dependent appliances.
items.reason_zh: libssh2在数据包读取时因未检查长度上限而导致越界写入，允许远程攻击者破坏堆内存并在依赖SSH的设备中执行代码。

items.reason_en: Tinyproxy improperly validates Host headers during stathost detection, permitting unauthenticated access to administrative statistics pages.
items.reason_zh: Tinyproxy在stathost检测过程中对Host头的验证不当，允许未授权访问管理统计页面。

items.reason_en: Session format mismatch between PHP and Node.js in the web terminal component triggers unauthenticated deserialization, granting immediate root-level code execution on control panels.
items.reason_zh: Web终端组件中PHP与Node.js之间的会话格式不匹配会触发未认证反序列化，从而在控制面板上直接获取root级代码执行权限。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the certificate plugin setup function allows authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary commands, compromising reverse proxy infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 证书插件设置函数中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证管理员执行任意命令，从而危及反向代理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in the Admin-Token cookie handling bypasses authentication entirely when started with specific flags, exposing DNS filtering appliances to unauthorized administrative control.
items.reason_zh: 在特定启动参数下，Admin-Token Cookie处理中的路径遍历漏洞可完全绕过身份验证，使DNS过滤设备暴露于未授权的管理控制之下。

items.reason_en: Authenticated users with template permissions can execute arbitrary Python code via malicious callables, compromising network infrastructure management and IPAM systems.
items.reason_zh: 拥有模板权限的已认证用户可通过恶意调用对象执行任意Python代码，从而破坏网络基础设施管理与IPAM系统。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized domain parameters appended to OS commands during allowlist updates allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on DNS filtering appliances.
items.reason_zh: 在白名单更新期间，未清理的域名参数被附加至操作系统命令中，允许已认证攻击者在DNS过滤设备上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Known exploited template injection allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on legacy file sharing servers, severely impacting network file distribution.
items.reason_zh: 已知被利用的模板注入漏洞允许未认证的远程攻击者在遗留文件共享服务器上执行任意命令，严重破坏网络文件分发服务。

items.reason_en: Copying attacker-controlled hostnames into fixed stack buffers without bounds checking enables remote code execution in CoAP protocol stacks commonly used in constrained network devices.
items.reason_zh: 在未进行边界检查的情况下将攻击者控制的域名复制到固定栈缓冲区中，可导致常用于受限网络设备的CoAP协议栈发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unescaped IRCv3 label tags in server replies enable server-to-server command injection, granting attackers elevated authority to control linked network nodes.
items.reason_zh: 服务器响应中未转义的IRCv3标签可触发服务器间命令注入，使攻击者获得提升权限以控制关联的网络节点。

items.reason_en: DNSSEC validation bypass accepts forged RRSIG signatures against incorrect zone keys, facilitating cache poisoning and traffic interception attacks.
items.reason_zh: DNSSEC验证绕过漏洞接受针对错误区域密钥的伪造RRSIG签名，从而助长缓存投毒与流量拦截攻击。

items.reason_en: Flawed NSEC3 closest-encloser verification matches hashes without validating type bitmaps, allowing on-path attackers to spoof non-existent domain proofs.
items.reason_zh: NSEC3最近封闭者验证存在缺陷，在匹配哈希值时未验证类型位图，允许路径攻击者伪造不存在的域名证明。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in TSIG RDATA decoding allows remote attackers to crash DNS resolvers via malformed records, directly disrupting critical network resolution services.
items.reason_zh: TSIG RDATA解码过程中的整数下溢漏洞允许远程攻击者通过畸形记录导致DNS解析器崩溃，直接中断关键网络解析服务。

items.reason_en: Untrusted DNS header fields dictate vector preallocation sizes, enabling memory exhaustion and denial-of-service attacks against vulnerable resolvers handling spoofed responses.
items.reason_zh: 不可信的DNS头部字段决定了向量的预分配大小，使攻击者能够对处理欺骗性响应的脆弱解析器实施内存耗尽与拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Exposes seven unprotected API routes in spacecraft interface managers, allowing unauthenticated network attackers to issue direct commands.
items.reason_zh: 航天器接口管理器暴露了七个未受保护的API路由，允许未认证的网络攻击者直接下发指令。

items.reason_en: Grants valid sessions and arbitrary spacecraft control capabilities without any credential verification in the graphical management interface.
items.reason_zh: 在图形化管理界面中无需任何凭据验证即可授予有效会话及任意航天器控制能力。

items.reason_en: CANBoat suffers from an off-by-one buffer overflow in its NMEA-2000 analyzer, allowing attackers to crash marine and automotive diagnostic tools via crafted bus messages.
items.reason_zh: CANBoat的NMEA-2000分析器存在差一缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可利用构造的总线消息导致海事与汽车诊断工具崩溃。

items.reason_en: libais uses an unchecked sentinel value as a vector index when parsing AIS sentences, enabling remote denial-of-service or system crashes in vessel tracking networks.
items.reason_zh: libais在解析AIS语句时将未检查的哨兵值用作向量索引，可在船舶跟踪网络中引发远程拒绝服务或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated epoch_time fields during program uploads corrupt the runtime database, potentially disrupting control loops and causing unpredictable behavior in programmable logic controllers.
items.reason_zh: 程序上传期间未验证的epoch_time字段会损坏运行时数据库，可能破坏控制循环并导致可编程逻辑控制器出现不可预测行为。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in WordPress s2Member plugin stems from insufficient sanitization of the item_name parameter, bypassing PHP tag stripping.
items.reason_zh: WordPress s2Member插件中的远程代码执行漏洞源于对item_name参数的清理不足，导致成功绕过PHP标签剥离机制。

items.reason_en: Arbitrary file upload in the payever WooCommerce gateway plugin leads to remote code execution via compromised WooCommerce-API callbacks.
items.reason_zh: payever WooCommerce网关插件中的任意文件上传漏洞可通过被利用的WooCommerce-API回调导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in WordPress LatePoint plugin enables account takeover by exploiting flawed query condition building during appointment scheduling.
items.reason_zh: WordPress LatePoint插件中的身份验证绕过漏洞可利用预约调度期间有缺陷的查询条件构建实现账户接管。

items.reason_en: Missing nonce validation in Laravel Socialite's Facebook provider allows unauthenticated attackers to replay captured OIDC id_tokens for account takeover.
items.reason_zh: Laravel Socialite的Facebook提供商缺失nonce验证，允许未认证攻击者重放捕获的OIDC id_tokens以实现账户接管。

items.reason_en: Improper Content Security Policy configuration in IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale allows remote attackers to bypass security restrictions and execute malicious scripts.
items.reason_zh: IBM WebSphere Extreme Scale中不正确的内容安全策略配置允许远程攻击者绕过安全限制并执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Authenticated users execute arbitrary OS commands via PHP object injection in email query parameters, fully compromising hosted mail servers.
items.reason_zh: 经身份验证的用户可通过电子邮件查询参数中的PHP对象注入执行任意系统命令，从而完全控制托管邮件服务器。

items.reason_en: Enables authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary PHP code through server-side template injection in incident reporting templates.
items.reason_zh: 允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过事件报告模板中的服务端模板注入执行任意PHP代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated attackers achieve remote code execution by uploading malicious pickle files that trigger unsafe deserialization in AI image generation platforms.
items.reason_zh: 未授权攻击者可通过上传恶意pickle文件触发AI图像生成平台中的不安全反序列化，从而实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Combines configuration file injection with SQL injection during installation to achieve immediate full application compromise.
items.reason_zh: 在安装过程中将配置文件注入与SQL注入结合使用，可立即导致应用程序被完全控制。

items.reason_en: AES-GCM initialization vector reuse across server lifetimes allows attackers to recover plaintext session states from enterprise single sign-on systems.
items.reason_zh: 在企业单点登录系统中，AES-GCM算法的初始化向量在整个服务器生命周期内重复使用，使攻击者能够恢复明文会话状态。

items.reason_en: Orkes Conductor contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability via malicious workflow definitions, directly compromising workflow orchestration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Orkes Conductor存在未授权远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可通过恶意工作流定义直接控制工作流编排平台。

items.reason_en: Hermes WebUI exposes an unauthenticated terminal API endpoint, allowing remote attackers to spawn PTY shells and execute arbitrary commands without credentials.
items.reason_zh: Hermes WebUI暴露了一个未授权的终端API端点，允许远程攻击者在无凭据的情况下生成PTY shell并执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Crawl4AI hardcodes a default JWT signing key in its Docker API server, enabling attackers to forge authentication tokens and bypass access controls entirely.
items.reason_zh: Crawl4AI在其Docker API服务器中硬编码了默认的JWT签名密钥，使攻击者能够伪造认证令牌并完全绕过访问控制。

items.reason_en: Hermes WebUI lacks origin restrictions on initial setup endpoints, allowing unauthenticated network actors to hijack first-run configuration and gain administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Hermes WebUI的初始设置端点缺乏源站限制，允许未授权的网络参与者劫持首次运行配置并获取管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Spatie Laravel Media Library bypasses upload restrictions by exploiting double-extension filenames, enabling malicious script uploads on vulnerable PHP web applications.
items.reason_zh: Spatie Laravel Media Library通过利用双扩展名文件名绕过上传限制，可在易受攻击的PHP Web应用中上传恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in captcha methods interpolates unsanitized User-Agent headers directly into database queries, enabling full backend compromise.
items.reason_zh: 验证码方法中存在未授权SQL注入漏洞，会将未经过滤的User-Agent头直接拼接到数据库查询中，从而导致后端被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Insufficient file extension validation in the admin code editor allows low-privilege users to upload and execute arbitrary scripts, leading to authenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 管理员代码编辑器中文件扩展名验证不足，允许低权限用户上传并执行任意脚本，进而导致经身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Authentication tokens are inadvertently exposed in HTTP response bodies during mail-link login flows, facilitating account takeover via simple network sniffing.
items.reason_zh: 在邮件链接登录流程中，HTTP响应体意外泄露了认证令牌，使得攻击者可通过简单的网络嗅探实现账户接管。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the CRM leads DataGrid permits authenticated users to extract sensitive business data by manipulating unparameterized query clauses.
items.reason_zh: CRM系统的leads DataGrid模块存在盲SQL注入漏洞，允许经身份验证的用户通过操纵非参数化查询子句提取敏感业务数据。

items.reason_en: Executable hooks parameter passed to Python's exec() with allowed builtins enables unauthenticated remote code execution in AI web scraping and automation services.
items.reason_zh: 将带有允许内置函数的可执行hooks参数传递给Python的exec()函数，可在AI网页抓取和自动化服务中实现未授权远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Template rendering capabilities can be exploited to pass arbitrary PHP callables to filters, bypassing sandbox restrictions and enabling code execution in modern web frameworks.
items.reason_zh: 模板渲染功能可被滥用以向过滤器传递任意PHP可调用对象，从而绕过沙箱限制并在现代Web框架中实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unsafe passing of session cookies to shell processing allows unauthenticated attackers to inject and execute arbitrary commands, demonstrating critical input validation failures in web applications.
items.reason_zh: 将会话Cookie不安全地传递给Shell处理过程，允许未授权攻击者注入并执行任意命令，暴露出Web应用中关键性的输入验证缺陷。

items.reason_en: Improper file extension validation allows uploading executable PHP files, leading to immediate remote code execution on document management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 不正确的文件扩展名验证允许上传可执行的PHP文件，导致文档管理与协作平台立即发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Flawed SameSite attribute implementation allows session cookie theft via crafted scripts, facilitating account hijacking in time-tracking and enterprise web applications.
items.reason_zh: SameSite属性实现存在缺陷，允许通过构造脚本窃取会话Cookie，助长时间追踪和企业Web应用中的账户劫持行为。

items.reason_en: Critical SQL injection in the fee sheet module allows low-privileged users to extract sensitive patient data by injecting constant subqueries into ORDER BY clauses.
items.reason_zh: 费用表模块存在严重SQL注入漏洞，低权限用户可通过在ORDER BY子句中注入常量子查询来提取敏感患者数据。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS vulnerability bypasses the HTML sanitizer's URL normalization, enabling persistent script execution when attackers inject javascript: href values into rich text editors.
items.reason_zh: 存储型XSS漏洞绕过了HTML清理器的URL规范化机制，当攻击者向富文本编辑器注入javascript: href值时，可实现持久化的脚本执行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via crafted filenames in the PDF/HTML converter allows unauthenticated remote code execution by leveraging shell metacharacters in file paths.
items.reason_zh: PDF/HTML转换器中通过构造文件名可导致OS命令注入，攻击者可利用文件路径中的Shell元字符实现未授权远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured CORS proxy instances act as open proxies, enabling SSRF attacks that expose internal endpoints and cloud metadata services to external attackers.
items.reason_zh: 配置错误的CORS代理实例充当开放代理，使攻击者能够发起SSRF攻击，从而将内部端点和云元数据服务暴露给外部。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in the fax module's disposeDocument function allows authenticated attackers to read database configuration files and write arbitrary payloads to the web root.
items.reason_zh: 传真模块的disposeDocument函数存在路径遍历漏洞，允许经身份验证的攻击者读取数据库配置文件并将任意载荷写入Web根目录。

items.reason_en: Maliciously crafted sparse arrays trigger excessive CPU and memory consumption during serialization, crippling web applications relying on Svelte.
items.reason_zh: 恶意构造的稀疏数组在序列化期间会引发过度的CPU和内存消耗，导致依赖Svelte的Web应用瘫痪。

items.reason_en: Supplying sparse arrays to the uneval function causes synchronous CPU amplification, effectively blocking event loops and denying service to web users.
items.reason_zh: 向uneval函数传入稀疏数组会导致同步CPU计算放大，有效阻塞事件循环并使Web用户无法获得服务。

items.reason_en: Repeated primitive strings cause quadratic expansion within uneval, rapidly exhausting server resources and halting application processing.
items.reason_zh: 重复的基础类型字符串会在uneval中引发二次方级扩展，迅速耗尽服务器资源并中断应用处理。

items.reason_en: Sparse array evaluation allocates memory proportional to declared length rather than actual size, leading to severe memory exhaustion flaws.
items.reason_zh: 稀疏数组求值会根据声明长度而非实际大小分配内存，导致严重的内存耗尽漏洞。

items.reason_en: Bypassing typed-array allocation checks via custom ArrayBuffer revivers allows attackers to allocate massive memory blocks and crash the runtime.
items.reason_zh: 通过自定义ArrayBuffer还原器绕过类型数组分配检查，可使攻击者分配海量内存块并导致运行时崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unhandled promise rejections during async serialization can leak internal errors or crash Node.js environments, destabilizing web backends.
items.reason_zh: 异步序列化期间的未处理Promise拒绝可能泄露内部错误或导致Node.js环境崩溃，从而破坏Web后端的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated internal forwards on legacy endpoints expose live session tokens over WebSockets, enabling immediate account compromise without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 遗留端点上的未验证内部重定向会通过 WebSocket 泄露活跃会话令牌，使攻击者无需认证即可立即接管账户。

items.reason_en: Accepting unsigned SAML assertions on ECP and HTTP-Artifact bindings completely bypasses authentication, allowing attackers to forge valid user sessions.
items.reason_zh: 在 ECP 和 HTTP-Artifact 绑定上接受未签名的 SAML 断言会完全绕过身份验证，允许攻击者伪造有效的用户会话。

items.reason_en: Lack of validation during self-registration permits anonymous users to assign themselves restricted administrative attributes and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 自助注册流程缺乏验证机制，致使匿名用户可自行赋予自身受限的管理员属性并提权。

items.reason_en: CSRF flaws in the OAuth 2.0 device flow trick logged-in users into approving unauthorized device codes, compromising account access.
items.reason_zh: OAuth 2.0 设备流存在 CSRF 漏洞，可诱骗已登录用户授权未经授权的配对码，从而导致账户访问权限被窃取。

items.reason_en: Sending unbounded serialized Java payloads to SDK and login endpoints triggers rapid resource exhaustion, taking down identity management services.
items.reason_zh: 向 SDK 及登录端点发送无限制大小的序列化 Java 负载会引发资源迅速耗尽，导致身份管理服务中断。

items.reason_en: Exploiting the page=0 parameter forces unbounded SQL queries and memory spikes, allowing authenticated users to degrade or crash the task management API.
items.reason_zh: 利用 page=0 参数可强制触发无限制的 SQL 查询与内存飙升，使已认证用户能够导致任务管理 API 性能下降或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Manipulating Kanban bucket moves via crafted task objects bypasses project isolation, exposing sensitive task data across different projects.
items.reason_zh: 通过构造任务对象操纵看板（Kanban）列的移动可绕过项目隔离机制，导致跨项目的敏感任务数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Deleting bots through misconfigured endpoints triggers automatic admin assignment, enabling team owners to escalate to full system administration.
items.reason_zh: 通过配置不当的端点删除机器人将触发自动管理员权限分配，致使团队所有者可提权至完整的系统管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable network-based vulnerability in Oracle Trusted Answer Search allows low-privileged attackers to compromise the application via HTTP.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Trusted Answer Search 中存在易于利用的网络漏洞，低权限攻击者可借此通过 HTTP 协议入侵该应用。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible vulnerability in Oracle REST Data Services Core component enables low-privileged attackers to compromise the middleware infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Oracle REST Data Services Core 组件存在网络可达漏洞，低权限攻击者可借此破坏中间件基础设施。

items.reason_en: Stacked SQL injection in sciphi-ai R2R allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary database statements by manipulating vector index creation parameters.
items.reason_zh: sciphi-ai R2R 存在堆叠式 SQL 注入漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过篡改向量索引创建参数执行任意数据库语句。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in MindsDB Platform occurs via an unprotected API endpoint that processes crafted prompts directly into system commands.
items.reason_zh: MindsDB Platform 存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可通过未受保护的 API 端点，将构造的提示词直接转换为系统命令执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in PostGIS address_standardizer triggers memory corruption when database users supply controlled relation names to standardize_address().
items.reason_zh: PostGIS 的 address_standardizer 模块存在越界写入漏洞，当数据库用户向 standardize_address() 函数传入可控的关系名称时，将触发内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds reads in dictionary compression iterators cause backend crashes or query integrity failures in time-series databases.
items.reason_zh: 字典压缩迭代器存在越界读取漏洞，可导致时序数据库后端崩溃或查询完整性受损。

items.reason_en: Allows SQL injection via unsanitized sort parameters in calendar modules, enabling data exfiltration from relational backends.
items.reason_zh: 日历模块未对排序参数进行过滤，导致 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可借此从关系型后端数据库中窃取数据。

items.reason_en: Injects arbitrary SQL through vector store search parameters, compromising data integrity in AI-powered database applications.
items.reason_zh: 通过向量存储搜索参数注入任意 SQL 语句，破坏了 AI 驱动数据库应用的数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Authenticated API users exfiltrate database contents by manipulating filter parameters in ERP REST endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 已认证的 API 用户可通过篡改 ERP REST 端点的过滤参数，窃取数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Feast contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in its registry server, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via crafted gRPC requests.
items.reason_zh: Feast 注册服务器存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，未认证攻击者可通过构造的 gRPC 请求实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: NVIDIA GEN3C deserializes raw HTTP bodies using Python pickle without authentication, granting unauthenticated remote code execution on AI inference servers.
items.reason_zh: NVIDIA GEN3C 在未进行身份验证的情况下使用 Python pickle 反序列化原始 HTTP 请求体，导致 AI 推理服务器存在未认证远程代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: vLLM lacks sparse tensor validation in multimodal processing, allowing attackers to submit malformed embedding requests that trigger out-of-bounds memory access and potential code execution.
items.reason_zh: vLLM 在多模态处理中缺乏对稀疏张量的验证机制，攻击者可提交畸形嵌入请求以触发越界内存访问，进而可能导致代码执行。

items.reason_en: Ray's WebDataset reader performs unsafe deserialization on tar archives, enabling remote code execution when processing untrusted machine learning datasets.
items.reason_zh: Ray 的 WebDataset 读取器会对 tar 归档文件执行不安全的反序列化操作，在处理不受信任的机器学习数据集时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded MySQL connection credentials embedded in public source repositories expose backend database infrastructure to unauthorized access and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: 公开源代码仓库中硬编码的 MySQL 连接凭证会使后端数据库基础设施暴露于未授权访问及横向移动风险之下。

items.reason_en: Lack of master-password re-authentication when retrieving SCIM API keys allows compromised sessions to harvest privileged integration credentials without additional verification.
items.reason_zh: 获取 SCIM API 密钥时未要求二次验证主密码，致使会话失陷后攻击者可在无额外验证的情况下批量窃取高权限集成凭证。

items.reason_en: Direct string interpolation in SQL statements without prepared statements allows authenticated attackers to extract or modify sensitive database records, compromising data integrity.
items.reason_zh: SQL 语句直接使用字符串拼接而未采用预编译语句，已认证攻击者可借此提取或篡改敏感数据库记录，破坏数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Unbounded 4-byte frame lengths cause memory exhaustion or connection hangs, enabling reliable denial of service against Kafka message brokers and distributed middleware.
items.reason_zh: 无限制的 4 字节帧长度会导致内存耗尽或连接挂起，攻击者可据此对 Kafka 消息代理及分布式中间件实施可靠的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Insufficient protection against mass assignment allows low-privileged users to elevate privileges by modifying restricted user attributes via exposed APIs, violating least-privilege controls.
items.reason_zh: 缺乏对批量赋值的有效防护，低权限用户可通过暴露的 API 修改受限的用户属性实现提权，违背了最小权限原则。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the SEO Panel archive module allows authenticated users to manipulate database queries and extract sensitive information via order parameters.
items.reason_zh: SEO Panel 归档模块存在盲注 SQL 注入漏洞，已认证用户可利用排序参数篡改数据库查询并窃取敏感信息。

items.reason_en: Broken object-level authorization in IBM API Connect allows authenticated attackers to access and exfiltrate sensitive backend data.
items.reason_zh: IBM API Connect 存在对象级权限控制失效漏洞，已认证攻击者可借此访问并窃取敏感的后端数据。

items.reason_en: SQL injection vulnerabilities in the API gateway enable attackers to extract, modify, or destroy underlying database contents.
items.reason_zh: API 网关存在 SQL 注入漏洞，攻击者可借此提取、篡改或删除底层数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Local code execution in IBM Qiskit SDK results from an out-of-bounds write triggered by improper input validation on corrupted unitary matrices.
items.reason_zh: IBM Qiskit SDK 存在本地代码执行漏洞，系因对损坏的酉矩阵输入验证不当，触发越界写入所致。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Frictionless allows attackers to execute arbitrary commands as the exploring user via shell metacharacters in data package descriptors.
items.reason_zh: Frictionless 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许攻击者通过在数据包描述符中插入 Shell 元字符，以数据探索用户身份执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Environment variable exposure in openclaw Crabbox forwards local secrets like API tokens and cloud credentials into remote command environments via malicious repositories.
items.reason_zh: openclaw Crabbox 中的环境变量泄露漏洞会通过恶意仓库将 API 令牌和云凭据等本地机密信息转发至远程命令环境。

items.reason_en: CSV formula injection in exceljs allows attackers to inject malicious formulas into exported spreadsheets, triggering data exfiltration or macro execution upon opening.
items.reason_zh: exceljs 中的 CSV 公式注入漏洞允许攻击者向导出的电子表格中注入恶意公式，在打开时触发数据外泄或宏执行。

items.reason_en: Executes arbitrary OS commands by leveraging malicious git configuration hooks triggered during repository operations in AI agent frameworks.
items.reason_zh: 利用 AI 代理框架中仓库操作期间触发的恶意 Git 配置钩子，执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Bypasses import guards to achieve arbitrary code execution by exploiting logic flaws in machine learning utility modules.
items.reason_zh: 通过利用机器学习实用模块中的逻辑缺陷绕过导入保护机制，实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Imports and executes attacker-controlled module names from checkpoint hyperparameters, enabling remote code execution in AI training pipelines.
items.reason_zh: 从检查点超参数中导入并执行攻击者控制的模块名称，从而在 AI 训练流水线中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Crashes local LLM servers by supplying crafted metadata files with exaggerated tensor dimensions that trigger uncontrolled memory allocation.
items.reason_zh: 通过提供包含夸大张量维度的伪造元数据文件，触发不受控的内存分配，导致本地 LLM 服务器崩溃。

items.reason_en: picklescan fails to detect nested eval calls in malicious pickle files, allowing unauthenticated attackers to bypass security scanning tools and execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: picklescan 无法检测恶意 pickle 文件中的嵌套 eval 调用，允许未认证攻击者绕过安全扫描工具并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Perry build server accepts unsanitized artifact paths via WebSocket, enabling malicious builds to write arbitrary files to locations accessible by the running process.
items.reason_zh: Perry 构建服务器通过 WebSocket 接受未过滤的制品路径，使恶意构建能够将任意文件写入运行进程可访问的位置。

items.reason_en: Charmbracelet wish SSH framework contains a path traversal vulnerability in its git middleware, allowing authenticated users to escape configured repository directories.
items.reason_zh: Charmbracelet wish SSH 框架在其 Git 中间件中存在路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证用户逃逸至配置的仓库目录之外。

items.reason_en: Broad substring matching on model names enables remote code execution in the privacy-filter dispatcher, threatening AI/ML pipeline integrity.
items.reason_zh: 对模型名称进行宽泛的子字符串匹配会导致隐私过滤器分发器中出现远程代码执行漏洞，威胁 AI/ML 流水线的完整性。

items.reason_en: Failure to block pkgutil.resolve_name allows complete bypass of Python deserialization blocklists, granting unrestricted remote code execution via crafted payloads.
items.reason_zh: 未能拦截 pkgutil.resolve_name 允许完全绕过 Python 反序列化黑名单，通过构造的有效载荷授予无限制的远程代码执行权限。

items.reason_en: Command injection in the Unix-like Artifacts Collector stems from unsanitized shell variable substitution, risking host compromise during digital forensics analysis.
items.reason_zh: 类 Unix 系统下的 Artifacts Collector 存在命令注入漏洞，源于未过滤的 Shell 变量替换，可能在数字取证分析过程中导致主机沦陷。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of pickle data in shared API endpoints enables unauthenticated remote code execution in image translation and AI utility services.
items.reason_zh: 共享 API 端点对 pickle 数据进行不安全的反序列化，使得图像翻译和 AI 实用服务中存在未认证的远程代码执行漏洞。

items.reason_en: Allowing ctypes.WinDLL invocation enables direct syscalls and raw memory access, bypassing sandbox protections to execute arbitrary commands during automated security scanning.
items.reason_zh: 允许调用 ctypes.WinDLL 可实现直接系统调用和原始内存访问，绕过沙箱防护，在自动化安全扫描期间执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Using distutils.file_util.write_file bypasses dangerous blocklists, enabling attackers to overwrite critical system files and achieve denial of service or remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 使用 distutils.file_util.write_file 会绕过危险黑名单，使攻击者能够覆盖关键系统文件，从而导致拒绝服务或远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Malicious MCP servers can declare arbitrary resources in metadata to obtain tokens for unrelated services, breaking OAuth trust boundaries in emerging AI agent ecosystems.
items.reason_zh: 恶意 MCP 服务器可在元数据中声明任意资源以获取无关服务的令牌，破坏新兴 AI 代理生态系统中 OAuth 的信任边界。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Scriban template evaluation bypasses expression depth limits, enabling denial of service through crafted recursive member chains.
items.reason_zh: Scriban 模板求值过程中的不受控递归会绕过表达式深度限制，通过构造的递归成员链导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Reflection-based object manipulation allows template authors to access .NET internals via delegate properties, leaking sensitive runtime metadata and method signatures.
items.reason_zh: 基于反射的对象操作允许模板作者通过委托属性访问 .NET 内部组件，泄露敏感的运行时元数据和方法签名。

items.reason_en: Forged checkpoint block bodies exploit incomplete cleanup routines to stall blockchain synchronization, disrupting network consensus.
items.reason_zh: 伪造的检查点区块体利用不完整的清理例程阻碍区块链同步，破坏网络共识。

items.reason_en: Transactions with excessive transparent inputs trigger quadratic verification complexity, exhausting node resources and halting chain processing.
items.reason_zh: 包含过多透明输入的交易会触发二次方验证复杂度，耗尽节点资源并中断链处理。

items.reason_en: Malicious peers can stall checkpoint synchronization by manipulating verifier rewind states after failed block commits.
items.reason_zh: 恶意对等节点可通过在区块提交失败后操纵验证器回滚状态来阻碍检查点同步。

items.reason_en: Flopping the mempool with script-failing transactions evades misbehavior scoring, preventing effective mitigation of resource abuse.
items.reason_zh: 使用脚本验证失败的交易充斥内存池可规避不良行为评分，从而阻止对资源滥用的有效缓解。

items.reason_en: Quadratic complexity in coinbase maturity checks allows connected peers to trigger severe performance degradation through crafted transactions.
items.reason_zh: Coinbase 成熟度检查中的二次方复杂度允许已连接的对等节点通过构造的交易引发严重的性能下降。
